title: ocai.incomplete
description: Marker sealed by StreamAccumulator onto every part an aborted stream left open: the stream died (no terminal streamStop arrived) before the part's partStop, so the part's content is whatever had accumulated at that point — explicitly flagged rather than silently passed off as complete. Emitted by the fold itself (ocai/chat/types/stream.py), never by a provider codec.
x-ocai-promotion: none expected — abortion is a transport accident, not a portable content attribute
